caption:
Mountain biking in Costa Rica is rarely about flat speed; it is about finding a rhythm on climbs that test your resolve. When I design our riding routes, I look for these hidden dirt tracks where the canopy closes in and the clay demands absolute focus. Every kilometre we ride is one I have personally scouted and tested to ensure it delivers that perfect balance of challenge and beauty. Which kind of terrain do you prefer to climb on?
